title: 1RB0RE_0LC1LE_0RD1LD_1RA1LF_1LC0RA_0LB---: no finite law for the cycle ends; with free residues it halts
text: The residues of Z at the cycle ends are the 2-adic digits of the orbit of a 3/2 map, so no finite law for them is to be expected. With the residues free, a halting path takes 17 cycle-level steps, and a concrete start with a 64,000-bit Z halts in the exact engine at phase 63,939. Random walks with fair bits halt at a flat rate of about 3.7·10<sup>-4</sup> per cycle-level step.
